candidate_sentences.text: AB KN Energies delivered strong financial performance for the nine months ended 30 September 2025, with consolidated revenue rising to EUR 76,664 thousand from EUR 67,977 thousand, a growth of approximately 13%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Operating profit increased to EUR 21.3 million (2025) from EUR 18.9 million (2024), driven by higher LNG regasification volumes, full terminal operational capacity (vs. 1.5 months downtime in 2024), and client capacity bonuses; partially offset by reduced LNG security supplement income due to regulatory excess return repayments.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Statement of Comprehensive Income and Note 13 (page 13)

candidate_sentences.text: Expansion was driven principally by the Liquefied Natural Gas Terminal segment, where regasification services revenue surged to EUR 43,640 thousand from EUR 31,401 thousand.

This increase stems from higher regasification volumes, client bonuses for booked capacity, and the return to normal operations following the prior-year dry-dock maintenance that caused a month and a half of downtime.
Consequently, gross profit rose to EUR 31,549 thousand, supporting a robust operating profit of EUR 21,282 thousand, up from EUR 18,942 thousand.

verified_key_information_units.information: Segment performance: Liquid Energy Terminals (LET) revenue was EUR 21.9 million (2025 vs EUR 21.1 million), LNG Terminal (LNGT) revenue rose to EUR 45.6 million (vs EUR 38.4 million), and commercial LNG activities revenue increased to EUR 9.2 million (vs EUR 8.5 million).

candidate_sentences.text: Expansion was driven principally by the Liquefied Natural Gas Terminal segment, where regasification services revenue surged to EUR 43,640 thousand from EUR 31,401 thousand.
Revenue from liquid energy products transshipment grew moderately to EUR 21,375 thousand.

Segment profitability reflected these trends, with the Liquefied Natural Gas Terminal contributing EUR 7,779 thousand to pre-tax profit and the Liquid Energy Terminals segment yielding EUR 5,293 thousand, while commercial LNG activities added EUR 9,240 thousand in revenue.

verified_key_information_units.information: Net cash generated from operating activities surged to EUR 76.3 million in 2025 from EUR 35.6 million in 2024, primarily due to higher net profit and net favorable working capital changes.

candidate_sentences.text: Operating cash flows more than doubled to EUR 76,331 thousand from EUR 35,637 thousand, underpinned by core operational cash generation, working capital improvements, and the reclassification of EUR 31,900 thousand in short-term deposits back to cash equivalents.

verified_key_information_units.information: Group borrowings decreased slightly to EUR 294.4 million (2025) from EUR 301.4 million (2024), while lease liabilities remained stable at approximately EUR 24 million. Cash and cash equivalents increased significantly to EUR 54.4 million from EUR 17.2 million.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Note 9 (page 11) and Statement of Cash Flow (page 6)

candidate_sentences.text: The cash and cash equivalents balance expanded significantly to EUR 54,398 thousand.

Total equity advanced to EUR 167,721 thousand, bolstered by retained earnings and reserve allocations, while the group maintained a prudent capital structure with borrowings at EUR 311,443 thousand and lease liabilities at EUR 25,063 thousand.

verified_key_information_units.information: Acquisition of a Floating Storage and Regasification Unit (FSRU) in December 2024, reclassifying the asset from right-of-use to property, plant and equipment.

candidate_sentences.text: Following the acquisition of the Floating Storage and Regasification Unit, depreciation expenses associated with this asset were reclassified to property, plant and equipment, embedding EUR 11,369 thousand of depreciation into cost of sales, compared to minimal amounts previously.

verified_key_information_units.information: Establishment of KN Energies Deutschland GmbH in September 2024 to operate the Wilhelmshaven 2 floating LNG import terminal for Deutsche Energy Terminal GmbH.

details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, and K6 are all PRESENT with supporting evidence in the candidate summary. K7 is MISSING as there is no mention of the establishment of KN Energies Deutschland GmbH in September 2024 to operate the Wilhelmshaven 2 floating LNG import terminal. The overall coverage is strong, capturing most HIGH importance criteria, but the absence of K7 prevents a perfect score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary demonstrates strong internal logical coherence. All statements build upon each other without contradiction: revenue growth is explained by segment performance (S2-S5), cost increases are justified by accounting changes (S6-S7), profit trends align with stated revenue and cost movements (S10), and cash flow improvements are supported by operational and reclassification factors (S16). The narrative flows logically from revenue drivers through to profitability, cash generation, and capital structure, with no internal inconsistencies or gaps. While some figures relate to different bases (e.g., segment vs consolidated), the candidate never claims they are directly additive components of the same total, so no arithmetic contradictions arise under the specified evaluation rules.
